stories.headline: Westfield Friends wins all five singles matches and hands Juniper Ridge its first loss
stories.byline: By Dale Kreuger | Courier staff writer
body: Juniper Ridge lost a dual at home Wednesday for the first time this season, and it lost every singles match doing it.

Westfield Friends, a 4A school from Fort Meriwether that went 27-2 and reached the state quarterfinals last season, beat the defending 5A champions 5-2. Senior Grayson Adkins beat Ezekiel Amoore 7-6, 6-2 at No. 1 singles, and the other four singles matches also went to Westfield, three of them in a third set.

Levi Chesnut, the sophomore who went 16-0 last season, lost for the first time in his varsity career, 6-2, 7-5 to senior Kevin Larue at No. 4. Deon Rennick took Maverick Kulp to a third-set tiebreak at No. 2 before losing 6-2, 2-6, 7-6.
Juniper Ridge's two points came in doubles. Christian Pulliam and Gabriel Clark won at No. 1, 6-4, 4-6, 6-1, and freshman Dimitri Kimball and Gage McConathy won at No. 2, 6-2, 6-2.
"They were better than us on Wednesday," Okafor said. "I'd rather find that out in August."

The day before, Juniper Ridge beat Pacersburg 7-0 without losing more than four games in a set. The day after, it opened the Kajaani League with a 6-1 win at Cedar Exchange, where Amoore won 6-1, 6-3 at No. 1 singles.
Juniper Ridge (3-1, 1-0 Kajaani) is at home Friday against Lateral Seven. Westfield Friends is 4-0.

stories.headline: Carroway's freshmen win at No. 1 doubles, and Jimmy Carter wins the dual
stories.byline: By Dale Kreuger | Courier staff writer
body: Carroway beat Pacersburg 7-0 on Wednesday and lost 4-3 at home to Jimmy Carter of Garrow on Thursday, and all four matches it lost Thursday went to a third set.

Luke Palm, who moved from doubles to No. 1 singles this season, beat Ryan Byram 6-0, 6-3, and Primitivo Delgado won 6-4, 6-4 at No. 2. Freshmen Uwe Fiebich and Rashad McCloud won at No. 1 doubles, 6-4, 3-6, 7-5.

Senior Michael Stevens won the first set at No. 5 singles 6-3 and lost the next two 7-6, 7-5 to sophomore Gabriel Fong. Freshman Leo Walton at No. 3 and junior James Stacy at No. 4 also lost in three.
"Every one of those went three sets," Haverkamp said. "That's experience, and the young ones will get it."
Carroway (1-1) opens the Juniper League on Friday at Ostrander Union.

stories.headline: League notebook: Calder is 2-0 and Senator Gray recovers
body: Calder followed its upset of Central West End with a 4-3 win over Obama in its Fiesta Athletic Association opener Wednesday. Calder lost No. 1 and No. 2 singles and won the dual in doubles, taking three of the four flights, while senior Luis Atteberry won 6-0, 6-4 at No. 3 singles. Calder (2-0) hosts Liberty Hill in a league dual Friday. Liberty Hill (2-2) lost its league opener 6-1 at Tidewater Catholic on Thursday.

Copper Gap opened the Desert Sky League with a 6-1 win over Aspen Hollow. Junior Jared Dixon won 6-1, 6-1 at No. 1 singles. Marlow County is 2-0 after a 6-1 league win over Archbishop Quinlan, with senior Jessie Smith winning 6-2, 6-3 at No. 1 and freshman Jayden Nielsen winning in three sets at No. 3.
Senator Gray lost 7-0 to Altamonte on Monday and then won 6-1 at Bitterroot and 5-2 at Ditch Fork. Cranston Diggins won both of his No. 1 singles matches, the first 6-4, 5-7, 7-6 over Joshua Cater.

Fairgrounds freshman Damien Paquette has played No. 1 singles in all three of his team's duals. On Thursday he lost the first set 6-0 to Las Colinas senior Alex Kunkel and won 0-6, 6-4, 6-3. Fairgrounds still lost the dual 4-3 and is 2-1.

High Desert Christian, 3-24 last season, beat Cornerstone Christian 4-3 on Tuesday and lost to Trinity Catholic by the same score a day later. Mt Jacqueline beat Copper Gap 4-3 on Tuesday and lost 7-0 at Mabryville, a 1A state semifinalist last season, on Wednesday.

stories.headline: Friday's league duals
body: Carroway is at Ostrander Union in the Juniper League, Juniper Ridge hosts Lateral Seven and Calder hosts Liberty Hill. Covenant is at Mission Terrace, Navrang hosts Box Canyon and Trout Lake hosts Seamus Town.

ledger: Juniper Ridge's loss to Westfield Friends was at home, Wednesday Aug. 6
